entries.name: Dierenarts van Wacht (telephone duty-vet finder, Flanders and Brussels)
entries.duty: Operator looks up vets on duty near you (about 20 km) and gives their numbers by voice or SMS; Dutch, French, English

duty_i18n.sl: Operater poišče dežurne veterinarje v vaši bližini (do približno 20 km) in vam posreduje njihove številke po telefonu ali SMS; v nizozemščini, francoščini in angleščini
duty_i18n.hr: Operater pronalazi dežurne veterinare u tvojoj blizini (oko 20 km) i daje njihove brojeve glasom ili SMS-om; na nizozemskom, francuskom i engleskom

entries.note: Commercial premium-rate telesecretariat (up to EUR 2.00 per minute, call limited to 10 min), NOT an official rota and not run by the vets' Order; operators are not vets. Show with the price warning.

entries.name: Antigifcentrum / Centre Antipoisons / Belgian Poison Centre (also takes calls about animals)
entries.quote: Heb je het antwoord hier niet gevonden, dan kan je ons steeds bellen op 070 245 245.
entries.note: Belgian Poison Centre (human centre) also takes enquiries about animals; page says: if you suspect poisoning in your pet, call your vet first, and only your vet can confirm the advice. Annual report 2025 (poisoncentre.be) records 5 190 calls about animals. Main line 02 264 96 36.
entries.duty: For animals the centre answers on 070 245 245 weekdays 8:00-16:00 and weekends/public holidays 10:00-16:00 (human emergencies take priority); otherwise call your vet

duty_i18n.sl: Za hišne ljubljenčke se center oglasi na 070 245 245 ob delavnikih 8–16 ter ob koncih tedna in praznikih 10–16 (nujni primeri pri ljudeh imajo prednost); sicer pokličite svojega veterinarja
duty_i18n.hr: Za životinje centar odgovara na 070 245 245 radnim danom 8:00–16:00 te vikendom i blagdanima 10:00–16:00 (hitni slučajevi kod ljudi imaju prednost); inače nazovi svog veterinara

notes: Researched 2026-11-03 with WebFetch only; WebSearch just to find URLs. Independently checked 2026-11-03 (runbook section 3). emergency_24h=true only where the page says 24/7, 24/24 or 'Heures d'urgence 00 - 24'. LEFT: (1) No official Orde der Dierenartsen / Ordre des medecins veterinaires / FAVV duty-rota page was found or fetchable (Belgian vets have no public official rota; searches returned none). (2) Belgian coast (Oostende, Knokke, De Panne, Blankenberge): no clinic's own page stating 24 h was found; only a blog list (hondenaanzee.be, not used as data) and AniCura WEST Oudenburg 19-22h. Coast vets still to look up on own sites. (3) BeVet-listed emergency clinic pages for Wanze and Florenville not opened individually (data from bevet.be find-a-vet page). (4) Not reachable or not in the fetch provenance set: shu-veterinaires.be (SHU Ath, 24h/24 claim only in l'Avenir 2023 article) and Animavet Cuesmes - own sites not found, so skipped; Cabinet de l'Orient Tournai refers night emergencies to Nordvet in La Madeleine (France), skipped. (5) Evidensia/other Flemish 24 h hospitals, Antwerp/Ghent/Bruges/Kortrijk independent 24 h clinics, Liege/Luxembourg province beyond Verviers/Herstal/Florenville not yet covered. (6) AniCura clinics without emergency hours (Meerhout, Westmalle, Hulshout etc. with 08-20h) omitted.
